answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at signed scaffolder certification with industry body attestation. It requires a card the industry body issued after an assessed build, so the prism of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the horizon is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the spiral is that asymmetry in plain numbers.
